threads.body:
CI now renders with the locked towncrier (26.9.0), but `tox -e changelog-preview` (what AGENTS.md tells contributors to run) still pins `towncrier==25.8.0`, so local and CI previews can drift. Maybe point the tox env at the lock too, or drop it and document this command instead?

```ini
[testenv:changelog-preview]
description = Render a draft changelog for every package that uses towncrier.
skip_install = true
allowlist_externals = uv
commands =
  uv run --locked --only-group towncrier python {toxinidir}/scripts/preview_changelogs.py
```

replies.body: Good catch! Updated `[testenv:changelog-preview]` in 43589574f94ef124cf92937bbc097e7aa2dd128f to use `tox-uv`'s `uv-venv-lock-runner` with `only_groups = towncrier` (and bumped `tox-uv>=1.30`, which introduced `only_groups`). That keeps `uv run tox -e changelog-preview` synced to the locked `towncrier` (26.9.0) inside `.tox/changelog-preview` without mutating `.venv` while `tox` is running from it.
